top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a falsifiable prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald flat bands at a magic angle) followed by the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, since reproduced widely and extended to other moire platforms. The citation can rest on flat bands and observed phases without claiming a pairing mechanism, which answers the maturity objection; the prediction-plus-demonstration split fits three names, though the Lopes dos Santos/Peres/Castro Neto and Cao/Dean/Young/Yacoby edges are real. P002 is the more mature and cleanly attributed fallback but is a measurement advance in a lineage already recognised in 2005 and 2012; P003 is scientifically solid but has the weakest credit allocation and only one explicit supporter; award is preferable to no award.
